claims.quote: The name comes from Bad Homburg in Hesse, in the German Empire, where it originated as hunting headgear.
claims.note: began as hunting hat in Bad Homburg

claims.quote: The homburg was popularised in the 1890s by the future Edward VII after he visited Bad Homburg in Hesse, Germany, and brought back a hat of this style.
claims.note: Edward VII brought hat from Germany
